title: thevetia nitida
intro: Thevetia nitida, commonly known as Yellow Oleander or Yellow Cassia, is a plant species native to tropical regions of Africa and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Thevetia nitida include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Thevetia nitida include thevetin, thevetin-A, and other compounds that have been studied for their potential therapeutic benefits, although more research is needed to fully understand their effects.
